# Vendored browser runtime

- Egret Engine community rebuild, branch main, pinned commit [0492498019ee329b82e343013210dcfe6e185885](https://github.com/cnedwin/Egret_rebuild/tree/0492498019ee329b82e343013210dcfe6e185885).
- The contracts, runtime and engine packages were built from that Git checkout (tree f1ba81a585bd7d6fc5d53efcc0b03ba0808a3c66).
- Built with Node.js 26.7.0 and TypeScript 7.0.2 using upstream `node tools/build.mjs`.
- robust-predicates 3.0.3 is the engine dependency. The original license is retained next to the package.
